notes: The 200 x 300 x 150 mm envelope includes the 6 mm outward rim; 2-degree draft therefore applies to the 188 x 288 mm wall top. Origin exception: body_bottom_center preserves the exact hinge x=102, z=152 mm datum; the forward tab makes the complete assembly bounding box asymmetric. The specification does not locate the 15 mm lid vertically; it is seated at Z150..165, crown Z162..165 and full 12 mm skirt Z150..162. This raised crown keeps all four skirts and avoids rear-skirt/body interference around the mandated high hinge. Label thickness and hinge hardware are additional details. Positive rotation about +Y opens upward toward +X; the illustrative -Y axis in section 1.8 would open downward. Frictionloss 0.4 N m exceeds the 0.25 kg lid's gravity torque and is intended to hold any opening angle; damping is 0.05. Snap catch return torque is 0.3 N m toward q=0 only within 0..3 degrees, to be implemented by the simulator, not as a full-range hinge spring. Body proxies expand the prescribed floor+four-wall decomposition with four rim bars to preserve the 6 mm overhang without filling the open cavity. Lid has exactly roof+four skirts+pull tab proxies. Pins, knuckles and compliant catch are non-contact hardware; the receiving groove is visual and must not lock the simulated hinge. Rounded proxy corners differ by up to 1 mm. Contents reuse flange_part, abs_housing and hex_blank; they are not copied or rebuilt. Metres, Z up, front -X; closed parts share the same prop frame, all transforms applied. Triangulated OBJ with normals, 30-degree smoothing and a nonoverlapping Smart UV 66-degree atlas. Each rigid part has a 2048-square, 8-bit sRGB albedo: CPU Cycles 64-sample DIFFUSE COLOR * (0.4 + 0.6 * AO), without direct light or highlights. Full Principled PBR is packed in source.blend. The 1024-square preview uses CPU Cycles 64, three lights, neutral grey and a front-left camera. Joint dynamics are integration parameters, not a claim of an executed robot episode. Generated with Blender 5.2.0 LTS. MuJoCo soft-friction defaults allow numerical creep even below the 0.4 N m threshold. Apply joint solimpfriction=[0.9999,0.9999,0.001] and solreffriction=[0.002,1] for static holding, with damping/frictionloss unchanged. Suggested body placement X445 mm puts the initial tab around X335 mm, visible to the head camera and inside the left hand workspace. The full 110-degree mechanical arc exceeds the fixed robot's nominal X window; task integration must use a partial opening or regrasp rather than assume one grasp follows the complete arc. The preferred 200 mm height band is also exceeded while opening. Task 13 compact OBJ exception: positions use 5 decimal metres where safe; necessary vertices retain up to 6 decimals to preserve nonzero triangles, strict collision convexity and the 0.005 mm Euclidean movement bound. Independent fixed-5 rounding cannot satisfy all three. Normals/UVs use 4 decimals; every original triangle, position index and per-corner attribute value is retained. Equal rounded UV records share indices and visual OBJ indices use shorter equivalent relative notation. No collision remeshing, reindexing or simplification. Task 13 delivery: baked albedos are Lanczos-downsampled to at most 1024 px except the unchanged-resolution factory-floor repeat tile; previews are 512 square. PNG encoding uses RGB8 or reviewed 256-colour Floyd-Steinberg palettes; source artwork pixels and source.blend are retained. Shared PNG paths resolve from this prop folder.
